content.title: Chapter 6 - ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES — Sec. 6-64. - Removal of a hearing officer.
content.summary:
All hearing officers shall serve at the pleasure of city council and may be prohibited
               from serving as a hearing officer of the authority, with or without cause, by majority
               vote of city council.
(
Ord. No. 4872
, § 2, 4-15-2024)

faqs.a:
All hearing officers shall serve at the pleasure of city council and may be prohibited
               from serving as a hearing officer of the authority, with or without cause, by majority
               vote of city council.
(
Ord. No. 4872
, § 2, 4-15-2024)
Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4872
, § 2, adopted April 15, 2024, repealed the former § 6-64, and enacted a new § 6-64
               as set out herein. The former § 6-64, pertained to chair; quorum; voting; appeals,
               and derived from
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018.
